title: Stuck Shutters Outside  (室外卡住的百叶窗)

segments.t: 来到庭院的鹅卵石上，格雷厄姆、汉娜和亚瑟站在侧墙那四扇被关了三十年的大木制百叶窗前。首先听一听完整的场景。
Funny, I walked past these gray shutters every morning and stopped seeing them!
Because the climbing ivy grew right across the middle iron hook!
Don't cut the vine, Hannah; lift the green branch gently onto the trellis.
Look! All the leaves stay safe, and now we can reach the iron latch!
Let me pull... ugh! It will not budge a single millimeter!
Oil first, muscle second, boss. Two drops on each hinge pin.
Give the oil ten seconds... now lift slightly and pull together!
One, two, there goes the left shutter!
And the right one! Look how big the courtyard looks with glass on two sides!
Wave through the clean window! Evelyn is smiling at the piano inside!
We definitely need fresh green paint on this dry gray wood tomorrow.
Sandpaper tonight, green paint Monday morning, if the sky stays dry.
现在我们来分析对话中的每个句子。
Funny, I walked past these gray shutters every morning and stopped seeing them!
“真奇怪，每天早晨我都会经过这些灰色的百叶窗，后来竟然都视而不见了！” 在 stop 之后，-ing 形式的动词表示完全停止某个习惯或感知：
stopped seeing them!
而 walked past 则描述从前面走过。
Because the climbing ivy grew right across the middle iron hook!
“因为攀缘的常春藤恰好从这边长到了那边，覆在了中间的铁钩上！” 爬墙的植物叫做
climbing ivy
而 grew right across 则展示了茎干是如何横跨过金属钩的。
Don't cut the vine, Hannah; lift the green branch gently onto the trellis.
“别剪断藤蔓，汉娜；小心地把绿色的枝条抬起来，搭到格子上。” 引导攀缘植物生长的交叉木条架叫做
onto the trellis.
这样就保住了绿色的枝条而不必将其剪断。
Look! All the leaves stay safe, and now we can reach the iron latch!
“看！所有的叶子都完好无损，现在我们够得到铁门闩了！” leaf 的不规则复数形式将词尾的 -f 变成了 -ves，即
All the leaves stay safe,
这里的 stay 相当于保持无损。
Let me pull... ugh! It will not budge a single millimeter!
“让我拉一下……哎！一毫米都不动！” 当我们再怎么用力，某个沉重或卡住的东西都不愿移动时，常用的否定动词就是 budge：
It will not budge
这里的 will not 表达了物体那种顽固的阻力。
Oil first, muscle second, boss. Two drops on each hinge pin.
“先上油，后使力，老板。每个铰链插销上滴两滴。” 格雷厄姆的修理名言幽默地对比了
Oil first, muscle second,
根本不需要任何动词。
Give the oil ten seconds... now lift slightly and pull together!
“给油十秒钟时间……现在稍微抬起来，同时拉！” 为了等一会儿让某个产品起效，可以用幽默的说法
Give the oil ten seconds...
仿佛油也需要属于它自己的时间。
One, two, there goes the left shutter!
“一，二，左边的百叶窗开了！” 当某样东西终于让步并在我们眼前开始移动时，生动的感叹是
there goes the left shutter!
并在 there 之后使用倒装。
And the right one! Look how big the courtyard looks with glass on two sides!
“右边也开了！看，两边都有玻璃，庭院显得多大啊！” 为了不在此形容词后重复 shutter 这个词，使用了万能代词 one：
And the right one!
而 how big the courtyard looks 则感叹着新空间显得如此宽敞。
Wave through the clean window! Evelyn is smiling at the piano inside!
“透过干净的窗户挥挥手！伊芙琳在里面的钢琴旁微笑呢！” 远远地挥手打招呼可以用一个动词来概括：
Wave through
而无需提到 the hand。
We definitely need fresh green paint on this dry gray wood tomorrow.
“明天我们肯定需要在这干枯的灰色木头上刷上一层新鲜的绿漆。” 谈到油漆，形容词 fresh 意思是“新涂的、新的”：
fresh green paint
为了让木头恢复生机。
Sandpaper tonight, green paint Monday morning, if the sky stays dry.
“今晚用砂纸打磨，周一早上刷绿漆，如果天不下雨的话。” 在涂漆前用来打磨木头的砂纸，将 sand（沙）和 paper（纸）结合成了
Sandpaper tonight,
而 stays dry 则带出了一项非常重要的天气预报。让我们再听一遍完整的场景。
Funny, I walked past these gray shutters every morning and stopped seeing them!
Because the climbing ivy grew right across the middle iron hook!
Don't cut the vine, Hannah; lift the green branch gently onto the trellis.
Look! All the leaves stay safe, and now we can reach the iron latch!
Let me pull... ugh! It will not budge a single millimeter!
Oil first, muscle second, boss. Two drops on each hinge pin.
Give the oil ten seconds... now lift slightly and pull together!
One, two, there goes the left shutter!
And the right one! Look how big the courtyard looks with glass on two sides!
Wave through the clean window! Evelyn is smiling at the piano inside!
We definitely need fresh green paint on this dry gray wood tomorrow.
Sandpaper tonight, green paint Monday morning, if the sky stays dry.
滴了两滴油，藤蔓也被小心地搭在了格子上，九号房间高高的窗户终于向着庭院敞开了。傍晚时分，我们马上见。
Have a good day!
